thread:
penny: FYI onboarding quickstart failed in CI when using the Node SDK. curl creates the route, SDK returns 400.

omar: can you paste the outgoing bodies?

penny: curl body: {
  \"name\": \"hi\",
  \"traffic_percentage\": 30,
  \"use_experimental_cache\": true
}

Node SDK send: {
  \"name\": \"hi\",
  \"trafficPercentage\": 30
}

server: 400 unknown parameter: traffic_percentage

jess: ah, camelCase normalization + unknown-key stripping. SDK converts to camelCase but server expects snake_case; experimental flag was dropped because not in typings.

penny: also saw duplicates in Dedicated tests when a token refresh happened mid-create. SDK retried POST and created two routes. curl does not retry.

ci-bot: Created RDW-1350: \"node-sdk param-casing + unknown keys stripped; unsafe retry for mutating ops\" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-1350

omar: quick fixes: 1) stop converting top-level keys for mutating requests, 2) preserve unknown keys (pass-through), 3) add automatic Idempotency-Key header for POST/PUT/PATCH when retrying.

jess: I'll own the serializer change and the pass-through fallback. penny, can you add a tiny e2e to sampleapp CI that posts an experimental key and asserts server received it?

penny: yes will add test and a quickstart note. patch release v1.14.2 sounds good.

omar: thanks team. small DX issues but big onboarding impact — prioritize this for the next patch release. :thumbsup:
